paragraphs: The “Toys & Games” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Toys & Games, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Game Timers, Games, Outdoor Play Equipment, Puzzles, Toys.

When describing products in Toys & Games, useful Shopify classification details include Toy/Game material: Identifies the main material used in a toy or game, such as plastic or wood; Color: Defines the primary color or pattern, such as blue or striped; Pattern: Describes the design or motif of a product, such as floral or striped. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.

The “Game Timers” category belongs to Toys & Games. It groups items under the official Shopify classification “Toys & Games > Game Timers”, keeping this product family distinct within its parent, Toys & Games. Its immediate branches include Analog Game Timers, Digital Game Timers.

When describing products in Game Timers, useful Shopify classification details include Timer count mode: Specifies the timer’s counting mode, such as counting down, counting up (stopwatch), both, or interval/repeating; Timer display type: Indicates how the game timer presents the remaining time (e.g., digital screen, analog dial, sand hourglass, or no visual display); Timer features: Describes the special functions of a timer, like adjustable duration or built-in display; Toy/Game material: Identifies the main material used in a toy or game, such as plastic or wood.
